paper_title: First Results from Axion Haloscope at CAPP around 10.7 $μ$eV
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (derived from stated KSVZ / 9xKSVZ sensitivity)
notes: Axion haloscope (CAPP-PACE). Paper reports exclusion in two regions: 10.7126-10.7186 ueV at near-KSVZ coupling sensitivity, and 10.16-11.37 ueV at ~8-10 (nominal 9) times KSVZ coupling, both 90% CL. No numerical g_agamma table given; values computed from KSVZ scaling g_KSVZ ~ 3.95e-16 * m_a[ueV] GeV^-1 and multiplied by ~9 for the wide-range points. Local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 as stated.
